motion: This house believes AI will ultimately benefit students.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: CA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: AI can personalize learning, catering to each student's unique needs.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: Established a core benefit of AI, framing the debate positively.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: SA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: However, over-reliance on AI could stifle critical thinking skills.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: Introduced a key counter-argument, highlighting potential drawbacks.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: CA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: AI isn't meant to replace teachers, but to augment their abilities.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: Addressed the concern about teacher displacement, strengthening CA's position.

outcome_summary: Both sides presented compelling arguments. While CA maintained a slight lead in confidence scores, SA successfully raised concerns about the potential downsides of AI. No clear shift in overall stance was observed.
limitations: Limited sample size of observer data.
